description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) 'PayGradeCurrencySearchFilterParams' used to encapsulate filtering parameters, specifically for searching pay grade currency information within the OrangeHRM admin module. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties such as payGradeId and sorting options.

classes.name: PayGradeCurrencySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object class for filtering pay grade currency search results, allowing for setting and retrieving pay grade ID and sorting preferences.

methods.name: setPayGradeId
methods.description: Sets the payGradeId property with a given integer value.

methods.name: getPayGradeId
methods.description: Returns the current value of the payGradeId property.
